poem.content:
In the digital realm, where data streams flow
A motor hums, a heart beats slow
A tooth of truth, a key to unlock
The secrets hidden, the tales to tell

A spy in the shadows, a whisper low
Explains the mysteries, as the creek below
Flows with a story, of a world untold
A pudding of knowledge, a bean of gold

A dial turns, a wheel in motion
A credit given, to a certain notion
A bulk of wisdom, a weight to bear
A tragic flaw, a heart to repair

But still we strive, to fix the past
To attract the light, to make it last
The ability to heal, to mend the tear
A digital dream, a world to clear

In the creek's dark depths, a secret lies
A tooth of knowledge, that only whispers rise
A spy in the shadows, a whisper low
A motor hums, a heart beats slow

The pudding of knowledge, a bean of gold
A credit given, to a certain notion bold
A bulk of wisdom, a weight to bear
A tragic flaw, a heart to repair

But still we search, for a way to be
A certain, a digital, a heart set free
To fix the past, to attract the light
To heal the wound, to make it right.
